submissions.sentence: A tool that takes a Shopify order export and returns a thermal packing decision per order using the forecast for the transit window.
submissions.clickFirst: Upload the sample CSV on the home screen, then open the Daily Pack List tab.
submissions.notes: Use zip code 67202 for a hot-day example. No login needed.

submissions.sentence: A summer subscription box for corporate clients, priced and planned around slow-season capacity.
submissions.clickFirst: Start at the pricing slider on the landing page, then scroll to the projections.

submissions.sentence: A kiosk app for the retail counter that logs which truffles a walk-in customer chose so the shop learns its bestsellers by weekday.
submissions.clickFirst: Tap Start Order and pick any three chocolates.
submissions.notes: Works best on a tablet-sized window.
